name: Dynamic Hamstring Sweep
instructions: Stand tall, step forward and extend one leg with the heel down and toes up.
Hinge at the hips, sweeping your hands down the extended leg toward the foot.
Keep the back flat — fold from the hips, not the waist.
Return upright and alternate legs as you walk forward.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight mobility drill targeting the hamstrings. Dynamic Hamstring Sweep restores range of motion that desk life and hard training both tend to steal.
